payload.rationale: Per the oracle relation contract, final numeric cyanide limits apply in a period when the compliance-schedule completion date has passed. The packet establishes that Cyanide final effluent limitations must be achieved 12 months after the permit effective date (page 6, Part I) and that the permit becomes effective on December 1, 2021 (cover page). Twelve months after December 1, 2021 is December 1, 2022. Federal FY2025 runs from 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (purpose A period). The entire FY2025 window lies after the December 1, 2022 schedule completion date, so the compliance-schedule completion date has passed for that period and final_limit_schedule_applies holds.
